observations: Industrial flatbed single-needle sewing machine head mounted on a metal/wood stand table.
Brand plate reads 'Emel' in red oval, visible on photo 1 and photo 3.
Photo 2 shows the machine on its table with a clutch motor underneath, treadle/pedal mechanism, and belt.
Paint is chipped/worn around the head casing in multiple spots (photos 1, 3).
Stand legs show surface rust and paint flaking (photo 2).
No accessories (bobbins, extra feet, oil can) or manual are visible in any photo.
No photo shows the machine powered on, threaded, or producing a stitch sample.
Needle and presser foot appear present and intact in close-up photos.

identity.kind: industrial straight-stitch sewing machine (flatbed, single needle)

claims.evidence: Brand plate visible in photo 1 and photo 3 reads 'Emel', not a brand associated with Japanese manufacture; no Japanese maker mark visible anywhere.
No video or audio of the machine running is provided; motor is only seen statically in photo 2.

claims.claim: All accessories and the original manual included
claims.evidence: No accessories or manual appear in any of the 4 photos; only the bare machine and table are shown.

claims.claim: Never serviced because nothing ever went wrong
claims.evidence: No service record, receipt, or internal mechanism photo provided.

risks.risk: Motor and drive mechanism may not actually run or may have electrical faults.
risks.proof: Short video clip of the machine powered on, pedal pressed, needle moving, and a stitched fabric sample.

risks.risk: Claimed accessories and manual may not be included in the sale.
risks.proof: Photo showing the manual and accessory kit (bobbins, extra feet, oil can) laid out next to the machine.
risks.if_unproven: priced as bare machine with no accessories

risks.risk: Internal gears, hook, or feed dog could be worn despite 'never serviced' claim.
risks.proof: Close-up photo/video of the bobbin area and feed dog, plus a stitch sample on fabric.

risks.risk: Stand/table rust and wear could indicate age or storage in damp conditions, affecting stability.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of all four stand legs and the table underside.
risks.if_unproven: priced as cosmetic-only wear, table condition as seen

risks.risk: Wiring/plug condition unknown, possible safety hazard.
risks.proof: Clear photo of the plug and wiring insulation.

proof_requests: Video of the machine running under power with a stitched fabric sample.
Photo of the manual and all claimed accessories laid out together with the machine.
Close-up photos of the bobbin case, hook, and feed dog area.
Close-up photos of all stand legs and wiring/plug.
response.reason: The item is clearly an industrial straight-stitch sewing machine with a readable 'Emel' brand plate, but the 'Japanese made' claim is contradicted by the visible brand, and functionality, accessories, and manual are unproven, so it must be priced at worst case as an untested bare machine.
